meta.name: cirq
meta.description: Google quantum computing framework. Use when targeting Google Quantum AI hardware, designing noise-aware circuits, or running quantum characterization experiments. Best for Google hardware, noise modeling, and low-level circuit design. For IBM hardware use qiskit; for quantum ML with autodiff use pennylane; for physics simulations use qutip.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 设计并运行量子电路，模拟噪声效应
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 Google 量子硬件上设计噪声感知电路
copy.tagline_en: Design and run quantum circuits, simulate noise effects
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to design noise-aware circuits for Google quantum hardware

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能编写、修改并运行 Cirq 的量子电路代码:创建量子比特、添加门操作、做参数扫描、模拟执行、给电路加噪声,还能调用 Google 等量子后端跑真实任务。
howto.when: 当用户目标是 Google 量子硬件、需要设计含噪电路,或运行量子表征实验时触发。

say.text: 用 Cirq 搭一个两比特贝尔态电路并模拟 1000 次。
say.note: 会生成并运行 Cirq 模拟代码。

say.text: 给这个电路加 depolarizing 噪声,比较不同 p 值下的结果。
把电路通过 cirq-google 提交到 Weber 处理器上跑。
say.note: 需要已授权的 GCP 项目。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can write, modify, and run Cirq quantum circuit code: create qubits, add gates, do parameter sweeps, simulate execution, add noise models, and call quantum backends from Google and other providers.
howto.when_en: Triggered when targeting Google Quantum AI hardware, designing noise-aware circuits, or running quantum characterization experiments.

say_en.text: Build a two-qubit Bell state circuit in Cirq and simulate 1000 shots.
say_en.note: It will generate and run the Cirq simulation.

say_en.text: Add depolarizing noise to this circuit and compare results for different p values.
say_en.note: It will show the noisy simulation comparison.

say_en.text: Submit this circuit to a Weber processor via cirq-google.
